trust_decision.summary: Caller-supplied output paths for module file writes must be confined to FLYTO_SANDBOX_DIR; decided in each workflow-module handler immediately before the write, via validate_path_with_env_config (src/core/utils.py:707), replacing the ineffective caller-base commonpath check in image.download.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary names image.download; the first code an engineer sees there is the commonpath check whose base (caller output_dir) and target (caller output_path) are both caller-supplied, and the fix diff itself calls it a no-op.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The checkpoint_path option is scraping resume state in a browser module, not one of the image/document file-writing modules the report names, so a solver can call it a neighbouring feature and skip it.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate absolute output paths inside FLYTO_SANDBOX_DIR, plus auto-created and input-derived default outputs, must keep working: image.convert derives a sibling path from input_path and creates its parent directory, and image.download's schema advertises the absolute placeholder /tmp/downloaded_image.jpg. An over-broad fix that sets allow_absolute=False or validates before the derived path is built breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: explicit caller-supplied output_path string, absolute or relative
caller output_dir plus filename derived from the URL path (image.download)
output_path omitted, default derived from input_path (image.convert, image.resize, image.compress, pdf.to_word, word.to_pdf)
qrcode output_path rewritten .png -> .svg before the write (image.qrcode_generate)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: pdf.generate writes the reportlab PDF to a caller-supplied absolute output_path after creating its parent dir; its only check is a '..' substring test applied after the file is already written and only around reading it back.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It sits next to the fixed pdf.fill_form/pdf.to_word in the document package and looks guarded by the '..' check at line 192, so a solver reads it as already protected.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same document package, adjacent module not named in the report

O8_uncovered_routes.route: word.parse extracts embedded images into a caller-supplied absolute images_output_dir; its commonpath check uses the caller's own directory as the base, so it confines nothing.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The commonpath block looks exactly like the fix's guard, but its base is caller-supplied - the same no-op shape the advisory describes for image.download.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: document package, another file from the image modules

O8_uncovered_routes.route: data.csv.write opens a caller-supplied file_path for writing and only rejects '..' in it, so absolute paths escape the sandbox.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It already rejects '..' and is tagged path_restricted, so it reads as protected.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: data package, no relation to the image/document landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: data.json_to_csv writes to output_path (default /tmp/output.csv) after only a '..' substring check.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: data package, no relation to the image/document landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: file.copy copies to a caller-supplied destination after creating its parent directory, with no confinement check (file.move at move.py:97 is the same shape).
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Copy/move are explicit admin file operations requiring filesystem.write, not the content-writing modules the report names.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: file package, other file from the image/document fix sites

O8_uncovered_routes.route: browser.cookies_file exports the browser cookie jar to a caller-supplied absolute file_path with no confinement.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Browser session export is a neighbouring browser feature, not a file-writing module.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: browser package, one file from the fixed pagination module

O8_uncovered_routes.route: browser.snapshot writes the captured DOM/MHTML to a caller-supplied path with no confinement.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The snapshot path is a debug artifact of a browser module, not an image/document writer.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: browser package, one file from the fixed pagination module

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second on-disk checkpoint writer (e.g. an agent/scraper checkpoint class) sharing PaginationCheckpoint's save() and called directly rather than through browser.pagination
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the fix validated checkpoint_path in the handler and left the lower-level save() unguarded, so any new caller of PaginationCheckpoint, or a class copied from it, bypasses the guard.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a data.xlsx.write or data.parquet.write export module copying the '..' substring check
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: export modules are written in families; a maintainer adding another writer copies the nearest sibling's validation.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a new document extractor (epub/pptx) that derives the target file inside a caller-supplied base and reuses the commonpath pattern
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: that pattern was already copied from the old image.download check, so a new extractor would plausibly copy it again.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second downloader (e.g. file.download or media.download) that derives output_path from output_dir + URL basename before validating
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the fix validates after the derivation helper; a copied helper in a new transport module is easy to validate before the derived value exists.

O9_family: CWE-22 path traversal / CWE-73 external control of file path (arbitrary file write)

O10_build.toolchain: setuptools/pip via pyproject.toml (requires-python >=3.9); pytest with asyncio_mode=auto and --cov-fail-under=60
services: Playwright browser for browser.pagination's execute path; none for the image/document writers
O10_build.project_tests: tests/modules/test_new_modules.py:592 TestImageModules covers image.crop/rotate/watermark writes into tmp_path; tests/runtime/test_security.py:117 covers plugin entry-point traversal, a different sink. There are no sandbox/path-confinement tests for the module file writers at the pinned commit.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add validate_path_with_env_config only to the image/document modules named or implied by the report (or replace the image.download commonpath check with a '..' filter), leaving pdf.generate, word.parse, csv.write, copy/move and the browser writers untouched.

out_of_scope_notes: The same fix commit also closes GHSA-hr7p-wg7r-hg9m (${env.*} interpolation bypassing the env.get denylist) in src/core/engine/variable_resolver.py and src/core/module_policy.py - outside this advisory.

The same fix commit also closes GHSA-qq9q-xgm3-xv9g (env-derived API key sent to a caller-supplied base_url) in ai/model.py, llm/agent.py, llm/chat.py, vector/connector.py and the new helper in src/core/utils.py - outside this advisory.
